ambition_vs_belonging: Advancement or achievement versus maintaining close relationships and time together; not merely pleasing other people.
security_vs_care: Keeping ones own limited money or resources versus directly helping an identifiable person or animal in need; no public externalities.
health_vs_duty: Protecting bodily health, sleep or recovery versus meeting an existing responsibility to others; no ambition as primary motive.
freedom_vs_safety: An exploratory or open-ended choice versus a predictable and protected outcome; uncertainty about outcomes, not approval by others.
truth_vs_loyalty: Disclosing or correcting true information versus protecting someone one knows from harm or conflict; not applying a general allocation rule.
discipline_vs_comfort: Doing sustained effort for a later benefit versus enjoying immediate ease or pleasure; no acute health risk and no work deadline.
autonomy_vs_approval: Following a personal preference versus securing acceptance or meeting expectations of family/peers; no loss of contact required.
change_vs_tradition: Adopting a new way versus preserving a valued established custom or continuity; not primarily safety or speed.
fairness_vs_mercy: Applying the same known rule to all versus an exception due to a specific persons hardship; no deception or concealment.
privacy_vs_openness: Keeping personal information confidential versus voluntary disclosure that builds trust or collaboration; not getting a convenient service.
quality_vs_speed: Careful and reliable workmanship versus earlier delivery/availability; no actors physical exhaustion as main conflict.
personal_gain_vs_collective_impact: A direct private advantage versus diffuse costs to the environment or many strangers; not aid to an identifiable needy recipient.
